config.authorization: User authorized direct MAE boosting then residual correction with current five features, identical walk-forward folds and earlier-only selection.
config.change_scope: Only RF gains listed PDF features; liquidation pair and nine-setting nested tuning protocol unchanged.
config.fit_accounting: 36 inner RF fits and 4 selected outer RF fits plus 4 joint selections per candidate.
config.promotion_rule: Promote only verified lower same-row MAE. Track Spearman only. Keep compact history and discard losing model/prediction artifacts after verification.
config.selection_exposure: PDF ranking and previous model results were inspected. Feature selection is historical development selection, not untouched confirmation.
config.stopping_rule: Only direct and residual boosting; 24 inner and four selected outer fits per approach. No further tuning based on outer results.
config.horizon_reuse: Target horizon, label-end column, input paths, folds and benchmark are explicit. Other horizons require matching target labels and separately generated/verified pair anchors and benchmark predictions. Never reuse 48h target/model artifacts for another horizon; no other horizons run in this experiment.
config.selection_rule: Lowest inner blend MAE; tie: lower RF weight, then incumbent settings, then shallower depth, then larger leaf.
config.residual_definition: Training target minus in-sample training-only liquidation pair prediction; no outer targets used. Retain signed corrections; clip only final magnitude to nonnegative.

result.interpretation: Earlier inner labels select depth, tree count and contribution. Pair model fixed. Residual targets, when used, are training-only in-sample residuals of the training-only pair. No outer labels used for fitting or selection. Adaptive development; fresh test untouched.

checks: training target hashes incl residual construction
native Booster replay of every inner score
